column1: # *** SO: TWO LERENA SIBLINGS MARRIED TWO CARDOZO SIBLINGS, and a generation later their children -
# CUSTODIO LERENA and EMA CARDOZO - petitioned to marry each other. DOUBLE FIRST COUSINS, *** which is
# why the dispensation runs to a diagram: the tie has to be traced twice.
# They asked to be excused the fee: "en cuanto a los honorarios de esta dispensa piden se les EXONERE
# de ellos pues NO PUEDEN SATISFACERLOS." *** A poor Lerena household, which is worth recording in an
# archive that has spent two days finding generals, judges and hacendados. *** This family was not all
# of one class.
# ================ *** AND A MARIA LERENA ON A DOCUMENT *** ================
# The standing question of this whole archive is the MARIA LERENA named on Pablo Armando's 1908
# enrolment card as his mother. *** THIS IS THE FIRST DOCUMENTED MARIA LERENA OF ROUGHLY THE RIGHT
# GENERATION THIS ARCHIVE HAS FOUND. *** She has a daughter of marriageable age in 1911, so a birth in
# the 1850s or 1860s - the right window.
# *** AND SHE IS ALMOST CERTAINLY NOT THE ONE. *** She married ELISEO CARDOZO, where Pablo Armando's
# mother is named beside JUAN CARLOS LERENA. Recorded as a candidate ruled out on the record rather
# than a name left lying about, because this archive has twice built on a Maria it had not pinned down.
# *** AND THE STANDING CONCLUSION SURVIVES ITS HARDEST TEST YET. *** Eleven Lerena dispensations are
# now on file and *** EVERY LERENA IN EVERY ONE OF THEM MARRIES OUT *** - Cardozo here, Gavarro in
# 1892, Massera in 1913. The consanguinity in this one runs through the CARDOZOS as much as the
# Lerenas. Not one Lerena-Lerena union in seventy-six years of the register.
